definition.def: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.
examples: He claimed that his parents had abandoned him. [VERB noun]
The road is strewn with abandoned vehicles. [VERB-ed]

definition.def: If you abandon an activity or piece of work, you stop doing it before it is finished.
examples: The authorities have abandoned any attempt to distribute food. [VERB noun]
The scheme's investors, fearful of bankruptcy, decided to abandon the project. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you abandon an idea or way of thinking, you stop having that idea or thinking in that way.
examples: Logic had prevailed and he had abandoned the idea. [VERB noun]

definition.def: If you abandon yourself to an emotion, you think about it a lot and feel it strongly, especially when other people might think you are wrong to do so.
examples: We are scared to abandon ourselves to our feelings in case we seem weak or out of control. [V pron-refl to n]

definition.def: If you say that someone does something with abandon, you mean that they behave in a wild, uncontrolled way and do not think or care about how they should behave. [disapproval]
examples: He has spent money with gay abandon.
Their permissiveness toward their children reflects the wild abandon of their own lives.

definition.def: If people abandon ship, they get off a ship because it is sinking.
examples: The officers and crew prepared to abandon ship in an orderly fashion.

examples.sentence: For many trees - evergreen conifers being an exception - the best strategy is to abandon photosynthesis* until the spring.
He had to abandon his training in 1917 when he was sent to France to fight in the First World War.
At times, he seemed to abandon the human figure altogether.

For instance, after the US public became concerned about the spread of a disease known as BSE, which was transmitted to humans through infected meat, the US government's Food and Drug Administration introduced rules demanding that the meat industry abandon practices associated with the risk of the disease spreading.
But to create a factory-built skyscraper, Broad had to abandon the principles by which skyscrapers are typically designed.
I mean I don't want to start off something and then have to abandon it, if they just can't cope with it.
